build: chain v4: Met-A on isolated neutrophils (EPIC v1) COMMISSIONED 2026-10-09; Met-A C-score on whole blood (EPIC v1) COMMISSIONED 2026-10-15; IAM-Deconvolver shares (neutrophils, monocytes, CD4 T, CD8 T; arrays) and IAM-A (healthy CD8 T cells, whole-genome bisulfite) COMMISSIONED 2026-10-17; a reading outside these scopes is printed as preliminary until its instrument is commissioned there
scope: tissue or an unnamed specimen (development): the IAM-Deconvolver splits it on IAM-Atlas v2.1's full panel, so the reading says what the sample is made of, and Met-A reads each cell it finds against the atlas in this sample's own shares; the commissioned Met-A and C-Score read whole blood and are not applied

sequencing_values.flag: values from sequencing molecules at IAM-Atlas v2.1's sites; not commissioned by our standards (development, to-do step 40)

reference_file.flag: DEVELOPMENT, diagnosis only: read against this Deconvolver reference, not the committed one
